notes: Aldi: NO coupon program — no Aldi coupons listed, per standing rule.

TWO separate DG $5-off-$25 coupons this week — they do NOT stack, one DG store coupon per transaction: the WEEKDAY coupon (Mon–Fri Nov 9–13, ends TODAY Fri Nov 13) and the SATURDAY coupon (Sat Nov 14 only). TheFreebieGuy and Nisha Bayless scenarios are built for Saturday. $25 is counted pre-tax, after instant savings, before manufacturer coupons. Shop Saturday baskets BEFORE ~3 PM — next week's sale prices activate early Saturday afternoon and can drop a basket below the $25 threshold and break the deal. On new touch-screen registers the $5-off-$25 digital may not deduct automatically — scan the $5-off-$25 coupon printed at the bottom of a previous receipt FIRST.

DG Seasonal Clearance Event Nov 13–19 (additional 50% off clearance): Charmin Essentials Soft 12 Mega Rolls $4.47 (reg $8.95), Downy Unstopables 10.7 oz $4.47 (reg $8.95), Old Spice Body Wash 16 oz $2.63 (reg $5.25), Febreze Car Vent Clips 2 pk $2.43 (reg $4.85), Old Spice Deodorant 2.6 oz $3.00 (reg $6.00). No coupon needed — scan in the DG app to confirm in-store.

Kroger: final week of the Mega Event (Buy 3 or more, Save $2 each) and the 5X Digital Coupon Event (limit 5 per transaction, unlimited transactions); the 99c Mix & Match sale continues (buy 5+ participating items, thru Nov 17); 4X fuel points on Friday purchases with the digital coupon. Digital coupons in the Kroger app under Savings. Aggregator lists are UNVERIFIED until seen in the app; prices vary by region. Kroger Krazy's 5X digitals page is image-only.

H-E-B: gallery strongest this run — all VERIFIED from heb.com, Nov 13 (935 coupons live). Best: $5 off $30 P&G basket (exp Nov 26); $10 off $50 Pampers/Luvs (exp Nov 26); $5 off 3 Crest/Oral-B/Burt's Bees/Native oral care (exp Nov 26); $5 off Gillette/Venus razor or refill (exp Nov 26); $4 off Tyson Frozen Buffalo Style Wings 40 oz (exp Nov 26); buy H-E-B Hickory Smoked Uncured Whole Carver Ham get FREE H-E-B Smokehouse Bacon 12 oz (exp Nov 26); 3 for $5 Dinamita/Doritos Flamas/Ruffles Queso chips 6.5–9.25 oz (exp Nov 26); buy 2 UPTIME Energy 12 oz get 2 FREE (exp Dec 8); buy H-E-B Sheet Pan Meals 32 oz get FREE Mootopia Ice Cream 1 pint (exp Nov 26); $2 off 2 Dannon Yogurts 32 oz (exp Nov 26). The gallery lists coupons, not shelf prices, so no dollar final price is stated for combo items. Full list in the repo data (coupons-2026-11-13.json).
Walmart: no coupon gallery — Walmart Cash manufacturer offers in the app, and offers vary by account. Walmart Cash posts after purchase and is spent on a future purchase.
CVS / Walgreens: ExtraBucks and Register Rewards are later rewards for a future purchase, not checkout discounts — final prices value them at face value, per the bloggers' math.

Target: Circle bonus offers are account-specific — your account may differ; activate before shopping. FREE $10 Target Gift Card with $100+ select gift cards (exp Nov 14, limit 1); 25% off one toy or kids' book with Target Circle (exp Nov 14); Thanksgiving Meal for 6 — $30 total, Nov 8–29, no coupon needed.
